Purpose
-------
Verify that CI does NOT run on pull_request events; it only triggers after
Code Reviewer Bot approves (pull_request_review.submitted).

Key ACs under test:
- AC1: No W1 or CI Orchestrator runs while PR is in draft state
- AC2: W1 fires on ready_for_review; CI orchestrator does NOT start on push
- AC3: CI Orchestrator fires exactly once on bot APPROVE event
- AC4: Post-approval push dismisses stale review; CI does not re-run until re-approval
- AC5: All 6 required status checks reported on the approved SHA
- AC6: merge_group event triggers CI (architectural skip: custom queue does not generate this)

Design spec refs: section 3.1, 6.2, 3.4, 14, G2

This probe file is intentionally inert - no code dependencies, no linting targets.
It exists solely to produce a minimal diff that the reviewer bot will APPROVE
on first pass with zero findings.
